title: NERDI: coordination and transfer of control
objective: Handle exit level changes from the next sector and flights that arrive without transfer, without losing the sector picture.
challenges: Next sector asks for a different exit level twice
Two flights reach the sector without transfer
criteria: Each flight leaves at the exit level agreed with the next sector
Flights without transfer assumed within 30 s of their first call
No loss of separation (5 NM / 1000 ft)

injects.text: The previous sector forgets to transfer an inbound flight. It calls you anyway.
injects.objective: Assumed within 30 s of its first call

injects.text: The next sector asks for another exit level. Accept or refuse, then clear it.
injects.objective: Answered within 60 s, and the aircraft leaves at the agreed level

injects.text: Another inbound flight arrives without transfer.
injects.objective: Assumed within 30 s of its first call

injects.text: The next sector asks to change an exit level again.
injects.objective: Answered within 60 s, and the aircraft leaves at the agreed level

injects.text: A transit asks for a higher level. Check the agreed exit level first.
